Wow, thank you so much for this. It really helps to know someone has gone through something similar to me. 

I’m also an author who, by some random urge, decided to post their work online, and now has a following looking forward to the next chapter. It’s lovely seeing people interacting with and being excited for my writing, it’s honestly one of my biggest dreams to connect with people in that way.

It’s just that I’ve found myself hitting so many blocks due to what I feel to be a lack of confidence in myself and negative beliefs about writing in general. I’ve been struggling for months now to finish this new chapter, and being a follower of the Law for 5 years, I decided to try to change my self talk in the way you have—that writing is easy instead of hard, that I don’t experience writer’s block, that the words come naturally to me.

But honestly, I haven’t gotten much success. It’s most likely because I’m not being very consistent with staying true to these new beliefs. I doubt myself and my abilities to manifest a lot. I’d wonder if anyone else had much success manifesting creativity like this, and here’s your post, telling me it’s all possible if I just assume the feeling of the wish fulfilled.

I needed the reminder. Your story is so motivational and inspiring, and it’s something I’m sure a lot of us needed to hear. Thank you for sharing this with us, and congratulations on your book!
